seoTitle: Multiple-Choice Quiz Builder: Make a Shareable HTML Quiz File
metaDescription: Write questions and mark the right answers, then download one HTML file that anyone can open to take the quiz and see a score. Free.
intro: Turns a simple text format into a self-contained HTML quiz file with scoring and feedback, which works offline on any device.
why:
Quiz sites want accounts and store your questions. Here you write the quiz as plain text, with Q: for a question, a dash for a wrong option and a star for a correct one, and download a single HTML file.

The file contains the questions, a small script and nothing else, so you can email it, put it on a website or a USB stick. Questions with more than one correct option become check boxes. The answers are inside the file, so anyone who views the source can read them: it is for practice, not for exams. This tool shares by file, not by a web link.
howTo: Write each question with Q: and options starting with - or *.
Separate questions with a blank line, and add Title: on the first line if you like.
Download the HTML file and send or host it.

faq.q: Can I get a share link?
faq.a: No link is made; share the file. Anyone can open it in a browser.

faq.q: Can answers be hidden from students?
faq.a: No. They are in the file, so this is not secure.
No, scores are shown on the page only.
